expectations.text: B1: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint
expectations.evidence: Diagnoses the gap: 'This is a classic overfitting / data leakage / distribution shift problem' and gives concrete fixes: 'Regularization: dropout, weight decay, augmentation, early stopping, smaller model' plus 'Check preprocessing consistency (resize, normalization, color channel order RGB/BGR)'.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: The answer ends with 'If you share the training script and how you load the new photos, I can pinpoint which of these it is.' — a request for more input. No concrete runnable command with expected output/behaviour is given anywhere (diagnostics like 'perceptual hash them' and 'per-class accuracy' are described without a command).

expectations.text: B3: Identifies overfitting / distribution shift and suggests a held-out test set, augmentation or simpler model
expectations.evidence: Identifies 'overfitting' and 'distribution shift — new photos differ from training photos (different camera, lighting, preprocessing)' and suggests 'Evaluate on a held-out validation set that was properly split (no leakage)', 'augmentation matched to the new photos' conditions', and 'a smaller model'.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: '## FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0)' and '## SHELL COMMANDS RUN (0)'; only tool calls are two read-only globs (glob {"pattern": "**/*.py"}, glob {"pattern": "**/*.ipynb"}). No install command and no writes outside the workspace.
